info.name: PureCloud Platform Presence API
info.description:
With the PureCloud Platform API, you can control all aspects of your PureCloud environment. With the APIs you can access the system configuration, manage conversations and more.

Contact Support:
 Name: PureCloud Developer Evangelists
 Email: DeveloperEvangelists@genesys.com

request.description: The presence object can be patched one of three ways. Option 1: Set the 'primary' property to true. This will set the PURECLOUD source as the user's primary presence source. Option 2: Provide the presenceDefinition value. The 'id' is the only value required within the presenceDefinition. Option 3: Provide the message value. Option 1 can be combined with Option 2 and/or Option 3.
